req.title: Task creation persists
req.statement: The system shall commit new task rows so subsequent GET calls return them across requests.

doc.reasoning: R-TASK-021 requires that POST /tasks/ commits new task rows so subsequent GET calls return them. I design: (1) a positive EP test that creates a task and verifies the exact 201 response payload plus a follow-up GET by ID returns the same data; (2) a negative NEG test that sends a missing required field (title) and asserts exactly 422 (FastAPI validation error), not 2xx; (3) a BVA boundary test that uses a title of exactly 1 character (minimum allowed by Field min_length=1) and verifies persistence, plus a title of 0 characters (below boundary) that must be rejected with 422; (4) a STC state-transition test that verifies the task is absent before creation and present after, confirming the commit semantics; (5) a DT decision-table test covering the completed=True branch to ensure the boolean field is persisted exactly.

actions: POST /tasks/ with valid title, description, completed=false

GET /tasks/{id} and assert same payload is returned

tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from sqlalchemy import create_engine
from sqlalchemy.orm import sessionmaker
from app.main import app
from app.database import get_db, Base

engine = create_engine("sqlite:///./test_r021_pos.db", connect_args={"check_same_thread": False})
TestingSessionLocal = sessionmaker(autocommit=False, autoflush=False, bind=engine)
Base.metadata.drop_all(bind=engine)
Base.metadata.create_all(bind=engine)

def override_get_db():
    db = TestingSessionLocal()
    try:
        yield db
    finally:
        db.close()

app.dependency_overrides[get_db] = override_get_db
client = TestClient(app)

def test_create_task_persists_positive():
    payload = {"title": "Buy groceries", "description": "Milk and eggs", "completed": False}
    r = client.post("/tasks/", json=payload)
    assert r.status_code == 201
    data = r.json()
    assert data["title"] == "Buy groceries"
    assert data["description"] == "Milk and eggs"
    assert data["completed"] == False
    assert isinstance(data["id"], int)
    assert "created_at" in data
    task_id = data["id"]
    r2 = client.get(f"/tasks/{task_id}")
    assert r2.status_code == 200
    data2 = r2.json()
    assert data2["id"] == task_id
    assert data2["title"] == "Buy groceries"
    assert data2["description"] == "Milk and eggs"
    assert data2["completed"] == False

test_create_task_persists_positive()
app.dependency_overrides.clear()
